about: Custom types P2: wolves (harness_type_a, skills [0,5,2,1]) stand in both raid rows by name. Moving them from the nest to a row leaves the food cost as it was, a row head draws through the custom head branch, the skill window of wolf class 1 shows skill 5 (hobgoblin class 1). With goblins they win stage 0 and come home (a won raid keeps its survivors in the rows). Then starvation with a desynced wolf count (mon_num > 0, no class has units) still ends.
